# Satu Koneksi Hotel

> We’re your multi-hotel room reservation specialist—curating the best room options across our hotel network and bringing them to you.

- Website: https://www.satukoneksihotel.com/
- WhatsApp (reservations): +62 895-3099-8988 - https://wa.me/6289530998988
- Where: hotel rooms in Indonesia (Bali, Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Lombok, Labuan Bajo and more), ASEAN (Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and more) and other cities worldwide on request; corporate, project-team and group stays.
- How: tell us the city, dates and guests on WhatsApp; we compare hotels and send one quotation with the total price; you pay by bank transfer and receive a booking number. No extra fees; the rate is confirmed before you pay.
- Languages: English · Bahasa Indonesia · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Bahasa Melayu · ไทย · 日本語 · 한국어 · Tiếng Việt
- Company: PT Satu Koneksi Hotel, a registered Indonesian company (NIB 2710260118389)

## Common questions
- How do I book? Tell us the city, dates and guests on WhatsApp or with the Book Now form. We compare hotels and send one quotation with the total price. You agree, pay by bank transfer (or as agreed for company billing) and receive a booking number and the hotel voucher.
- Is there a booking fee? No extra fees: the price in the quotation is the total, including taxes and service, and it is confirmed before you pay.
- Where can you book? Hotels across Indonesia, ASEAN cities and other cities worldwide on request - just name the city.
- Can you book for a company or a group? Yes: staff travel, project teams and groups up to 200 rooms, with a rooming list, through one contact.
- How do I pay safely? By bank transfer to our company account only; we never ask for card numbers, PINs or OTP codes.
- What about cancellation? Each hotel has its own rules; we write them in your quotation before you pay. Every step: https://www.satukoneksihotel.com/how-it-works
